stage2_patch.explanation: about.php previously called dvwaPageStartup( array( ) ) with an empty action list, so no authentication check ran and unauthenticated visitors received HTTP 200 (vertical privilege escalation / unauthorized admin-only page access). The patch changes only that startup call to dvwaPageStartup( array( 'authenticated' ) ), reusing the project's exact validated guard semantics: dvwaPageStartup checks in_array('authenticated', $pActions), calls dvwaIsLoggedIn(), and issues dvwaRedirect( DVWA_WEB_PAGE_TO_ROOT . 'login.php' ) to deny and exit before any page content is rendered. This mirrors index.php, phpinfo.php, security.php and all vulnerability pages. Session handling is already initialized by the included dvwa/includes/dvwaPage.inc.php, so no additional session_start() is required. The guard is placed before $page construction and dvwaHtmlEcho output, so unauthorized requests are blocked before any protected content is returned, while the authorized authenticated admin role continues to receive the page unchanged. No unrelated code was modified.
